alignment_software.alignment_parameters:
Pairwise sequence aligner with parameters
  substitution_matrix: BLOSUM62 (pinned BioPython 1.86 matrix)
  open_internal_insertion_score: -10.000000
  extend_internal_insertion_score: -0.500000
  open_left_insertion_score: -10.000000
  extend_left_insertion_score: -0.500000
  open_right_insertion_score: -10.000000
  extend_right_insertion_score: -0.500000
  open_internal_deletion_score: -10.000000
  extend_internal_deletion_score: -0.500000
  open_left_deletion_score: -10.000000
  extend_left_deletion_score: -0.500000
  open_right_deletion_score: -10.000000
  extend_right_deletion_score: -0.500000
  mode: local

source_classification_coverage.interpretation: A missing CATH assignment or boundary is unknown. Negative sequence screening does not supply the missing structural classification.

limitations: CATH annotations are the versions integrated in the pinned RCSB snapshots, predominantly v4_3_0; absence does not imply a novel fold.
All deposited protein entities and source domains were screened; training-PDB co-entities can overflag exposure. Each hit records whether its entity matches the dataset author-chain hint.
Percent identity uses nongap residue-residue columns as frozen before calculation. Gap-inclusive identity is reported descriptively; it is not an alternative outcome-dependent acceptance rule.

Full chains and source-defined CATH/SCOP2 domains include non-recognition domains. Recognition-domain assignment and ambiguous sequence warnings need independent source adjudication before a family split is certified.
CHEN11-fpocket is 251 rows and 241 unique PDB entries, not 11 proteins. This audit does not audit score-calibration/feature-table provenance, GNINA or all historical learned-model training.
ProtGlycanDock exact train overlap for 3ZWE and valid overlap for 1I3H remain as recorded in the candidate inventory; this P2Rank audit cannot clear them.

sequence_warning_summary.interpretation: Prespecified percent/coverage screen warnings; short, gap-rich, repeat-driven and cross-fold matches are not automatically credible evolutionary homologs.
